sloka: स दूरं सहसोत्पत्य दुर्धरस्य रथे हरिः ।निपपात महवेगो विद्युद्राशिर्गिराविव ।। ५.४६.२५।।।।
transliteration: sa dūraṁ sahasotpatya durdharasya rathe hariḥ ।nipapāta mahavego vidyudrāśirgirāviva ।। 5.46.25।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman suddenly leaped far off into the air at high speed and fell on Durdhara's chariot just like a thunderous lightning falls on a mountain.
